name: satchel
description: Build agent plugin manifests from one product-agnostic source package.

interface.shortDescription: Build agent plugins from one source package.
interface.longDescription: Product-agnostic authoring tools for agent extensions. Satchel keeps satchel.yaml as the source of truth, then generates host-specific plugin files and checks generated-file drift.
defaultPrompt: Use Satchel to add or validate a product-agnostic agent plugin package.
